name: Zhongshan
registryBasis: Zhongshan’s Natural Resources Bureau publicly announced its “One Map” platform for public planning and cadastral/property-natural-attribute queries. The live public shell and its client configuration are directly reachable. The client combines cadastral identification/detail data and does not document a geometry-only layer schema or an attribute-filtered vector endpoint.
pointBasis: UN WUP 2025 population-weighted settlement centroid; this is not a municipal boundary or a parcel-coverage claim.
technicalBlocker: The live client exposes cadastral search/identify routes whose data contract is a general POST payload and whose feature-detail workflow includes parcel and property attributes. No geometry-only field-selection schema or public OGC/vector service was verified. No search, click-identify, parcel/unit-code lookup, building-name lookup, or export was submitted.
scopeLimits: Inspected the official Natural Resources Bureau announcement, anonymous map shell, Global.js configuration, and app bundle. The cadastral interface advertises searches by parcel code, real-estate unit number, or building name and coordinate identify; these are property-identification paths, not a verified geometry-only route. No login, credentials, property names, addresses, legal parcel identifiers, owners, or feature attributes were queried.
remainingUncertainty: Whether an anonymous map-view geometry endpoint exists behind the public viewer independently of its cadastral search/identify/detail paths; whether a safe field-filtered vector schema can be obtained from the advertised map service.
